description: This file defines the Criteria class, which manages the data and operations related to 'criteria' in the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, validating, saving, and reordering criteria entries within different sections, as well as managing localized content.

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: Model class representing criteria items with functionalities to retrieve, list, validate, save, and reorder criteria entries within different sections, supporting localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific criteria entry by ID with optional language support.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all criteria entries within a specified section, considering localization and language settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the criteria object's required fields before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the criteria object to the database, inserting or updating as needed, and manages ordering.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a criteria item up in the order within its section.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a criteria item down in the order within its section.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for a new criteria in a section.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Returns an array of available sections with localized headers.
